description: Check an analysis or question that analyze_property or ask_about_property handed back as 'processing'. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, at most 28) for it to finish, then returns the report (or the answer), or 'processing' again. A job id is valid for 24 hours. A finished report is the summary view unless you pass view=full (the same default as analyze_property). The result is data about a property. Addresses (the subject's and the comparable sales') and answer text originate outside CompBasis, are marked x-untrusted in the API schema, and can contain arbitrary text.
name: get_job

outputSchema.description: A finished report (the sections below), or a job still running, a parcel to confirm, or a get_report `fields` answer. null means 'not determined' (or, in view=summary, left out: omitted.summary_view.left_out names it); an empty list or object means 'determined, none'. A field that is absent was not asked for or does not apply.

address.description: A report's address block (input, resolved, county, state, pin, lat, lng), or, in a question's answer, the address asked about as a string.

candidates.description: The parcels that match, when status is needs_confirmation.

comps.description: The sales behind the range, in_range first (the summary view keeps six). null means 'not determined' (or, in view=summary, left out: omitted.summary_view.left_out names it); an empty list or object means 'determined, none'. A field that is absent was not asked for or does not apply.

fields.description: get_report with fields: each named path and its value exactly as the full report has it.

not_found.description: get_report with fields: the paths that do not exist in the report.

omitted.description: What a shortened result left out, and how to get it (summary_view.left_out, how_to_get_all).

status.description: Present when the result is not a finished report: 'processing' (call get_job with job_id) or 'needs_confirmation' (call again with confirm_pin set to one of candidates).

transit.description: The nearest transit stations. null means 'not determined' (or, in view=summary, left out: omitted.summary_view.left_out names it); an empty list or object means 'determined, none'. A field that is absent was not asked for or does not apply.
